latest_release.name: DeskBox 1.5.9
latest_release.body:
# DeskBox 1.5.9

DeskBox 1.5.9 is a feature update: Windows 11-native right-click menus, a calmer and more capable updater, a recovery offer after configuration wipes, Korean language support, a clear notice on fully elevated desktops, and a wide reliability pass over widgets, drag-drop, and memory.

Released on October 23, 2026.

## Highlights

- **Windows 11-native right-click menus.** A single column of inline-icon rows in Explorer's classic order, rendered directly on acrylic; "Open with" lists real associated apps including UWP with icons; "New"/"View"/"Sort by" submenus on the blank area; native ZIP compress (tar variants, multi-select) and extract. Namespace shortcuts (This PC, Recycle Bin, Control Panel) inherit their target's verbs.
- **A calmer, more capable updater.** Daily wall-clock-anchored checks with failure back-off, actionable update-toast buttons, automatic release notes after an update, background downloads that skip metered connections with a ready toast, a stage-following status badge, version navigation across the full published history in the update log (identical on every machine, offline-readable once viewed), and an in-flight activity card in settings; background download and update notifications get separate switches.
- **A recovery offer after a configuration wipe.** When a launch detects missing settings plus a surviving snapshot that passes the hard gates, a one-time window offers restore-or-fresh; scheduled snapshots pause until the decision lands.
- **Korean language support.** The interface, installer, and first-run experience ship in Korean alongside the existing 12 languages, plus a full translation-quality pass over the 1.3.8-era machine translations.
- **A clear notice on fully elevated desktops.** A one-time startup notice explains why dragging out of widgets is unavailable when the whole desktop runs as administrator (UAC off, built-in Administrator, or company-managed), with the exact way back for Pro, Home, and alternate accounts; the drag-drop diagnostics attribute the same, and an acknowledged notice never returns.
- **The tray icon can be hidden.** A "Hidden" tray icon style: no icon at startup, immediate runtime switching, no revival on taskbar recreation.
- **Steadier widgets.** Placement survives display-topology changes, edge-docked bars stop jumping to a corner on reveal, group-tab capsules expand promptly on re-entry, revealing after hiding is prompt again, and the todo color submenu no longer crash-closes the app on Windows 11 25H2 (a font file 25H2 removed behind a leftover registration).

See `CHANGELOG.md` for the complete list.

The direct installers are Full Native AOT builds with the bundled private Windows App Runtime — fully offline installation. Installers are currently unsigned. Verify the SHA-256 checksums after downloading.

### Microsoft Store upload

| File | Architectures | Size | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| `DeskBox_1.5.9.0_x64_arm64.msixupload` | x64 + ARM64 | 45.06 MiB | `F0D66275709A50ABB1B69D1D8D21B12080CB90D8A494F9682B3195D322D3B405` |

This combined `.msixupload` is the only file from this section intended for Partner Center. It contains `DeskBox_1.5.9.0_x64_arm64.msixbundle` plus the matching x64 and ARM64 `.appxsym` files. The internal bundle is version `1.5.9.0` and has SHA-256 `9ACD22C7CDCB7CA8440CFFA0205D8F308B2B8425916BC93EF95D83211DDE06FD`.

The two single-architecture `.msixupload` files produced during per-architecture auditing are intermediate evidence only and must not be submitted as the final DeskBox Store release.
